name: Blood Pressure
overview: Scripture reveals that God has provided for our physical well-being through His creation, giving us herbs and fruits for nourishment (Genesis 1:29). Obedience to God's commands brings protection from disease, as He promises healing and deliverance through His word (Exodus 15:26; Psalms 107:20). The life of the flesh is intimately connected to the blood, which God has set apart for atonement and spiritual restoration (Leviticus 17:11), underscoring the sacredness of life and health in His design. These truths encourage believers to honor God by stewarding their bodies and trusting His provision for healing.
